deficits.evidence: 4_or_more lanes and a signalised, marked or raised crossing without a refuge
deficits.suggestion: Install a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the wide road to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at the zebra crossings to improve accessibility for pedestrians and wheelchair users.

deficits.evidence: an urban road with street_lighting none
deficits.suggestion: Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers, especially during low-light conditions.

ratings.reason: The road is wide with a marked crossing but no central refuge island.
The kerb edges at the crossing are not clearly visible in the frames.
Street lighting poles are visible along the road.
